subject: maths
question: A is 40% more efficient than B. How much time will they take to work together to complete a job, which A alone could have done in 31 days?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The efficiency ratio of A : B = 7 : 5

Total work will be 31 × 7 = 217 units

The number of days required by together will be,

⇒ 217 / (7+5) = 217 /12 days

**∴ The correct option is 1**
